2609.30977.title: Does Uniform Discrete Diffusion Need Time?
2609.30977.paper_summary: Uniform discrete diffusion models (UDMs) commonly use explicit time conditioning, but we find that it can often be unnecessary in practice. In this paper, we first show that the population-optimal UDM predictor generally depends on time: time controls how much the model should trust the observed context. We then show that this dependence can become negligible in finite-data settings relevant to language. When a corrupted training sequence remains much closer to its original clean sequence than to competing training sequences, the empirical-optimal predictor is nearly insensitive to time over most of the diffusion trajectory, where the guarantee weakens toward the high-noise endpoint. Empirically, trained language UDMs exhibit limited time sensitivity over most of the trajectory, while time-agnostic predictors remain competitive with, and often outperform, time-conditioned models across datasets and training objectives. These results challenge the use of explicit time conditioning in UDMs: although the population optimum depends on time, explicitly conditioning on it may often be unnecessary in practice.
2609.30977.paper_summary_zh: 均勻離散擴散模型（UDMs）通常使用顯式時間條件，但我們發現這在實踐中往往是不必要的。<lb/>在本文中，我們首先表明，人口最優的 UDM 預測器通常依賴於時間：時間控制模型應該多大程度上信任觀察到的上下文。<lb/>然後我們表明，這種依賴在與語言相關的有限數據設置中可以變得微不足道。<lb/>當一個被損壞的訓練序列與其原始乾淨序列的距離遠小於與競爭訓練序列的距離時，經驗最優預測器在擴散軌跡的大部分區間對時間幾乎不敏感，而保證在高噪聲端點的情況下會減弱。<lb/>從經驗上看，訓練過的語言 UDM 在大部分軌跡上表現出有限的時間敏感性，而不考慮時間的預測器在各個數據集和訓練目標上與時間條件模型保持競爭，並且往往表現更佳。<lb/>這些結果挑戰了在 UDM 中使用顯式時間條件的做法：儘管人口最優解依賴於時間，但在實踐中顯式地對其進行條件化往往是不必要的。
